subject: API base path for all v1 endpoints
value: /api/v1

subject: Authentication middleware using JWT Bearer tokens
value: Authorization header with Bearer token; JWT verified against config secret; user loaded from DB; deleted_flag=0 checked

subject: Permission middleware checks permission codes per route
value: RequirePermission(code, roleRepo); checks permCodes from team scope or queries roleRepo.HasPermission for non-team routes; SuperAdmin bypasses all checks

subject: Team scope middleware verifies team membership and injects permCodes
value: Parses teamId as bizKey from URL; resolves to team record; checks membership (SuperAdmin bypasses); when role_key is NULL, falls back to 'member' preset role; injects permCodes into context

subject: Fallback when member role_key is nil/NULL
value: TeamScopeMiddleware falls back to querying 'member' preset role by name when member.RoleKey is nil; source: backend/internal/middleware/team_scope.go:62-75

subject: Authentication error response
value: {"code":"UNAUTHORIZED","message":"authentication required"} with HTTP 401

subject: Authorization error response
value: {"code":"FORBIDDEN","message":"insufficient permissions"} with HTTP 403

subject: Permission-denied error with specific code
value: {"code":"ERR_FORBIDDEN","message":"权限不足：缺少 <code> 权限"} with HTTP 403

subject: Validation error response
value: {"code":"VALIDATION_ERROR","message":"request validation failed"} with HTTP 400

subject: Item not found error response
value: {"code":"ITEM_NOT_FOUND","message":"item not found"} with HTTP 404

subject: Invalid status transition error response
value: {"code":"INVALID_STATUS","message":"invalid status transition"} with HTTP 422

subject: Cannot modify terminal main item error
value: {"code":"TERMINAL_MAIN_ITEM","message":"cannot modify a completed or closed main item"} with HTTP 422

subject: Target main item closed error for sub-item move
value: {"code":"BAD_REQUEST","message":"目标主事项已关闭"} with HTTP 400

subject: Move to same main item error
value: {"code":"BAD_REQUEST","message":"不能移动到同一主事项"} with HTTP 400

subject: Team not found error response
value: {"code":"TEAM_NOT_FOUND","message":"team not found"} with HTTP 404

subject: Not a team member error
value: {"code":"NOT_TEAM_MEMBER","message":"not a member of this team"} with HTTP 403

subject: Main item list endpoint
value: GET /api/v1/teams/:teamId/main-items (perm: main_item:read); supports assigneeKey, status query params; returns items, total, page, size

subject: Main item status change endpoint
value: PUT /api/v1/teams/:teamId/main-items/:itemId/status (perm: main_item:change_status); body: {status: string}

subject: Main item delete endpoint with cascade
value: DELETE /api/v1/teams/:teamId/main-items/:itemId (perm: main_item:delete); cascade soft-deletes all sub-items; creates status_history audit records

subject: Sub-item delete endpoint
value: DELETE /api/v1/teams/:teamId/sub-items/:subId (perm: sub_item:delete); soft-deletes; creates status_history audit; recalculates parent completion

subject: Sub-item move endpoint
value: PUT /api/v1/teams/:teamId/sub-items/:subId/move (perm: sub_item:update); body: {targetMainItemBizKey: string}; returns {newSubCode, mainItemBizKey}

subject: Sub-item update endpoint
value: PUT /api/v1/teams/:teamId/sub-items/:subId (perm: sub_item:update); body: {title, description, priority, assigneeKey, startDate, expectedEndDate}

subject: Team list endpoint (filtered by membership)
value: GET /api/v1/teams (auth only, no perm code); returns only teams the user belongs to; SuperAdmin sees all

subject: Weekly view endpoint
value: GET /api/v1/teams/:teamId/views/weekly (perm: view:weekly); query: weekStart (YYYY-MM-DD, must be Monday, not future)

subject: Gantt view endpoint with terminal item filter
value: GET /api/v1/teams/:teamId/views/gantt (perm: view:gantt); query: assigneeKey, status; returns items with sub-items; terminal items with no activity hidden when inactive=true

subject: Move operation rejects same parent
value: sub_item_service.Move checks subItem.MainItemKey == targetMainItemBizKey and returns ErrSameMainItem; source: backend/internal/service/sub_item_service.go:310

subject: Move operation rejects terminal target
value: sub_item_service.Move checks IsMainTerminal(targetMainItem.ItemStatus) and returns ErrTargetClosed; source: backend/internal/service/sub_item_service.go:305

subject: Main item list with assignee penetration logic
value: When assigneeKey filter is set, returns matchType ('direct' or 'indirect') and matchedSubItemIds for each item; source: backend/internal/service/main_item_service.go:297-417

subject: Terminal items sorted to bottom of list
value: sortTerminalItems uses sort.SliceStable to sink terminal (completed/closed) items to bottom while preserving relative order; source: backend/internal/service/main_item_service.go:714-723

subject: Main item delete cascades to sub-items in single transaction
value: CascadeSoftDelete soft-deletes main item and all sub-items atomically with status_history audit records; source: backend/internal/service/main_item_service.go:267

subject: Status history audit record created on deletion
value: RecordStatusChange called with to_status='deleted' for both main items and sub-items on soft-delete; source: backend/internal/service/main_item_service.go:244-264, sub_item_service.go:221

subject: Parent completion recalculated after sub-item delete
value: RecalcCompletion called after sub-item soft-delete; source: backend/internal/service/sub_item_service.go:224

subject: Completion recalculated for both source and target after move
value: RecalcCompletion called for both sourceMainItemBizKey and targetMainItemBizKey; source: backend/internal/service/sub_item_service.go:332-336

subject: Standard success response envelope
value: {"code": 0, "data": <payload>}

subject: Main item valid status transitions
value: Validated via status.IsValidTransition(MainItemTransitions, current, target); self-transition rejected; terminal guard checks all sub-items are terminal; source: backend/internal/service/main_item_service.go:462-489

subject: Sub-item code auto-generated on move via atomic increment
value: NextSubCode atomically increments main item's sub_item_seq; source: backend/internal/service/sub_item_service.go:318

subject: Team list filtered by user membership
value: ListTeams filters by userBizKey for non-superadmin users; SuperAdmin sees all teams; source: backend/internal/handler/team_handler.go:56-75

subject: Weekly view weekStart must be Monday and not future
value: weekStart parsed as date; validated to be Monday; validated not after today; source: backend/internal/handler/view_handler.go:32-57

subject: All entity IDs exposed to frontend use snowflake bizKey (int64 formatted as string)
value: BizKey generated via snowflake.Generate(); exposed as string via pkg.FormatID(); parsed via pkg.ParseID(); source: backend/internal/model/base.go

subject: All deletions are soft-delete via deleted_flag
value: SoftDelete sets deleted_flag; queries use NotDeleted() scope; data is never permanently removed; source: repository pattern

subject: MilestoneMap create endpoint
value: POST /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestone-maps (perm: milestone:create); body: {mapName(1-100,required), mapDesc, assigneeBizKey(required), planStartDate, expectedEndDate}; initial status: planning

subject: MilestoneMap list endpoint
value: GET /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestone-maps (perm: milestone:read); filter: name, assigneeKey, status; returns items, total, page, size

subject: MilestoneMap get endpoint
value: GET /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestone-maps/:mapId (perm: milestone:read); returns enriched VO with milestoneCount, itemCount, overallProgress

subject: MilestoneMap update endpoint
value: PUT /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestone-maps/:mapId (perm: milestone:update); body: {mapName, mapDesc, assigneeBizKey, planStartDate, expectedEndDate}; validates date range; returns updated VO

subject: MilestoneMap delete endpoint with cascade
value: DELETE /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestone-maps/:mapId (perm: milestone:delete); cascade: soft-delete all milestones + clear MI milestone_keys in single transaction; only planning/reviewed/ready deletable

subject: MilestoneMap status change endpoint
value: PUT /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestone-maps/:mapId/status (perm: milestone:update); body: {status: string}; validates transitions; cancelled cascades to milestones+MIs

subject: MilestoneMap available transitions endpoint
value: GET /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestone-maps/:mapId/available-transitions (perm: milestone:read); returns filtered transitions based on current status and milestone terminal check

subject: Milestone create endpoint
value: POST /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestone-maps/:mapId/milestones (perm: milestone:create); body: {milestoneName(1-100,required), milestoneDesc, expectedEndDate(required)}; parent map must not be terminal; initial status: not_started

subject: Milestone list by map endpoint
value: GET /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestone-maps/:mapId/milestones (perm: milestone:read); returns items with computed completion and relatedMICount

subject: Milestone list by team endpoint
value: GET /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestones (perm: milestone:read); filter: name, status, excludeCancelled; returns items with completion and relatedMICount

subject: Milestone get endpoint
value: GET /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestones/:milestoneId (perm: milestone:read); returns enriched VO with completion and relatedMICount

subject: Milestone update endpoint
value: PUT /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestones/:milestoneId (perm: milestone:update); body: {milestoneName, expectedEndDate, milestoneDesc}; parent map must not be terminal for name/date changes; duplicate name check

subject: Milestone delete endpoint
value: DELETE /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestones/:milestoneId (perm: milestone:delete); cascade: clear MI milestone_keys in transaction; only not_started/cancelled deletable

subject: Milestone status change endpoint
value: PUT /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestones/:milestoneId/status (perm: milestone:update); body: {status: string}; validates transitions; cancelled auto-unbinds all MIs; completed requires all MIs terminal; parent map must not be terminal

subject: Milestone available transitions endpoint
value: GET /api/v1/teams/:teamId/milestones/:milestoneId/available-transitions (perm: milestone:read); returns filtered transitions; parent map terminal => empty list; filters completed if MIs not all terminal

subject: MilestoneMap status state machine and transitions
value: planning -> {reviewed, cancelled}; reviewed -> {ready, planning, cancelled}; ready -> {executing, reviewed, cancelled}; executing -> {completed, ready, cancelled}; completed/cancelled are terminal; source: backend/internal/pkg/status/milestone_status.go

subject: Milestone status state machine and transitions
value: not_started -> {in_progress, cancelled}; in_progress -> {completed, cancelled}; completed -> {cancelled, in_progress}; cancelled is terminal; source: backend/internal/pkg/status/milestone_status.go

subject: Parent map is terminal error
value: {"code":"MAP_IS_TERMINAL","message":"里程碑图处于终态"} with HTTP 400

subject: Duplicate milestone name within map error
value: {"code":"DUPLICATE_NAME","message":"同名里程碑已存在"} with HTTP 409

subject: Milestone has non-terminal items error
value: {"code":"BAD_REQUEST","message":"里程碑下存在未完成的事项"} with HTTP 400

subject: Map has non-terminal milestones error
value: {"code":"BAD_REQUEST","message":"里程碑图下存在未完成的里程碑"} with HTTP 400

subject: Terminal milestone cannot receive items error
value: {"code":"BAD_REQUEST","message":"终态里程碑不可接收事项"} with HTTP 400

subject: Map cannot delete in current status error
value: {"code":"INVALID_PARAMS","message":"当前状态不允许删除里程碑图"} with HTTP 400

subject: Milestone cannot delete in current status error
value: {"code":"INVALID_PARAMS","message":"当前状态不允许删除里程碑"} with HTTP 400

subject: MilestoneMap delete cascades in single transaction
value: Delete soft-deletes all milestones under the map, clears milestone_key on all related MIs, then soft-deletes the map; source: backend/internal/service/milestone_map_service.go:193-219

subject: MilestoneMap cancel cascades milestones and unbinds MIs
value: Cancelled status cancels all non-terminal milestones and unbinds all MIs in single transaction; source: backend/internal/service/milestone_map_service.go:250-284

subject: Milestone cancellation auto-unbinds all associated MainItems
value: ClearMilestoneKeyByMilestone called to set milestone_key to null for all MIs; source: backend/internal/service/milestone_service.go:234-242

subject: MilestoneMap delete only allows planning/reviewed/ready
value: BR-4: only planning, reviewed, ready can be deleted; executing/completed/cancelled rejected; source: backend/internal/service/milestone_map_service.go:188

subject: Milestone delete only allows not_started/cancelled
value: BR-4: only not_started and cancelled can be deleted; in_progress/completed rejected; source: backend/internal/service/milestone_service.go:184

subject: MilestoneMap completed requires all milestones terminal
value: BR-2: all milestones under the map must be in terminal states (completed/cancelled) to transition map to completed; source: backend/internal/service/milestone_map_service.go:237-247

subject: Milestone completed requires all MIs terminal
value: BR-1: all associated MainItems must be in terminal states (completed/closed) to transition milestone to completed; source: backend/internal/service/milestone_service.go:221-231

subject: Terminal parent map blocks milestone create/update
value: BR-5: parent MilestoneMap must not be terminal for milestone create and status-relevant updates; source: backend/internal/service/milestone_service.go:61-63,110-117

subject: Milestone completion is average of associated MI completions
value: Completion = sum(MI.Completion) / count(associated MIs); 0 for empty milestone; computed on read via buildMilestoneVO; source: backend/internal/handler/milestone_handler.go:258-266

subject: MilestoneMap VO enriched fields
value: VO includes: bizKey, teamKey, creatorKey, creatorName, assigneeKey, assigneeName, mapName, mapDesc, mapStatus, statusName, planStartDate, expectedEndDate, milestoneCount, itemCount, overallProgress; source: backend/internal/vo/milestone_vo.go

subject: Milestone VO enriched fields
value: VO includes: bizKey, teamKey, milestoneMapKey, milestoneName, milestoneDesc, expectedEndDate, milestoneStatus, statusName, completion, relatedMICount; source: backend/internal/vo/milestone_vo.go

subject: MainItem has nullable milestone_key for milestone binding
value: MilestoneKey *int64 field on MainItem model; null means unassigned; set via bind, cleared via unbind; source: backend/internal/model/main_item.go:24

subject: Milestone name must be unique within a map
value: ExistsByNameAndMap checks for duplicate milestone names within the same map (excluding self on update); source: backend/internal/service/milestone_service.go:66-72,123-129
